Players Committee card image of [[Bravo Fighter (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. May add one astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Immune to attrition < 3.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/bravofighter.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
